notes.title: Update 1.5.2 - Speedrun mode!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone! [/h2]
The latest Krypta FM update, version 1.5.2, is now available for download! It introduces [b]speedrun mode[/b] and a few minor fixes.

[h3]Speedun mode lets you skip the radio broadcast and go straight into exploring the village.[/h3]

To turn on the speedrun mode, you simply have to open settings and check the box.
[b]But, if you're going to play Krypta FM for the first time[/b] - please consider not skipping the broadcast, because it contains a lot of useful info.


[h2]Full list of changes[/h2]
[i](Warning: may contain game spoilers)[/i]

[list]
[*] Added version number to menu
[*] Added collision to Maluch in the village
[*] Changed the location of the sign on the train station gate
[*] Translated user ranks on forum
[*] Fixed user stars on forum
[*] Fixed bed interact bug
[*] Fixed next/previous buttons in the wallpaper viewer
[*] Fixed folder names
[*] Adjusted mouse sensitivity settings
[*] Removed debug buttons that were left from the debug version of the game
[*] [spoiler]Changed "vault" to "bunker" in some forum posts[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Changed "Hunter94" to "Hunter95" in the car ranking post[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Changed "place of power near tracks" to "place of power on the clearing near tracks" in journal[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Changed "transformator" to "transformer" in some places[/spoiler]
[/list]
We are aware of other bugs and we will try to fix them in future updates.

[h2]Happy hunting![/h2]
